_note:
Batch 19 — Biohacking & Human Optimisation. Nine, not the twenty asked for, and the shortfall is the finding rather than a failure of effort: the businesses that would obviously fill this category are already in the directory. Perth Cryo, Recovery Lab Jolimont, Locked In Recovery, Ultimate Recovery Lounge, Recovery Haus Innaloo, Bodyspace, Modern Ritual Contrast, Reload Strength Clinic, MH Performance Coaching and three float centres are all live under Spa & Recovery. Re-listing them here would give two categories the same businesses, which is the thing that teaches visitors categories mean nothing.

So these are the ones that belong here and nowhere else: measurement and programmed performance rather than a room with a sauna in it. Researched from each business's own website; details left empty are details that were not published, never guesses.

On wording: nothing here says a test or a program treats, prevents or improves any condition. A scan is described as a scan. The Longevity Lab and Perth Dexa Scan share a Wellington Street address and the Longevity Lab name appears inside Perth Dexa Scan's own service list, so they are very likely one business with two brands — flagged rather than presented as independent, and the CBD Dexa location is deliberately not listed twice.

categories.name: Biohacking & Human Optimisation
categories.blurb: Body composition and VO2 max testing, biomarker panels, athletic development and performance programming across Perth.

listings.name: The Longevity Lab
listings.blurb: A Wellington Street testing clinic built around measurement rather than treatment: body composition, aerobic capacity, blood biomarkers, DNA and gut microbiome, with a biological age figure drawn from the results.
listings._source: thelongevitylab.com.au — Wellington Street suite, phone and the full test list confirmed on its own site. Opening hours and a public email are not published. Shares a building with Perth Dexa Scan and appears in that business's service list; likely the same company under two names.

listings.name: West Coast Health and High Performance
listings.blurb: A Lathlain clinic that runs a testing menu alongside its practitioners — body composition, aerobic capacity, blood lactate, strength and power, gait — with physiotherapy, exercise physiology and podiatry in the same building.
listings._source: westcoasthealth.com.au performance testing page — address, phone, email and the priced test menu confirmed. priceFrom is the lowest listed test (gait analysis, $70). Also filed under Allied Health, which is what its physio and podiatry side is.

listings.name: High Performance Lab
listings.address: 1/187 Scarborough Beach Road, Mount Hawthorn WA 6016
listings.blurb: Athletic development on Scarborough Beach Road, working with emerging and elite athletes and with police and emergency services candidates preparing for entry testing. Screening and evaluation come before the programming.
listings._source: highperformancelab.net — address, mobile, email and the athlete, tactical and online coaching offer confirmed on its own site. Format recorded as both because online programming is listed alongside the gym.

listings.name: Next Level Performance S&C
listings.blurb: A purpose-built strength and conditioning room in Bayswater working with individual athletes, with force-plate testing to set the programme and review sessions to change it. There is a recovery lounge on site.
listings._source: nlpsc.com — Radius Loop address, mobile, email, VALD force-plate testing, recovery lounge and the review-session model confirmed on its own site. Opening hours not published.

listings.name: Trench Health & Fitness
listings.blurb: A Shenton Park studio combining coached swimming and cycling with a gym floor, and body composition scanning for members who want the numbers behind the training.
listings._source: trenchhealth.com.au health services page — Lemnos Street address, mobile, and the DEXA, swim, cycle and nutrition offer confirmed. No public email published.

listings.name: Perth Dexa Scan — Subiaco
listings.blurb: Body composition scanning and aerobic capacity testing on Hay Street, one of six rooms this business runs across the metro. Appointments are for the scan itself rather than a consultation.
listings._source: perthdexascan.com.au — Subiaco address and its own direct phone number confirmed on the site's locations list. No public email. The CBD room is not listed separately because it shares an address with The Longevity Lab above.

listings.name: Perth Dexa Scan — Joondalup
listings.blurb: The northern room of a metro scanning business, on Franklin Lane. Body composition and aerobic capacity testing, booked directly rather than through a referral.
listings._source: perthdexascan.com.au — Joondalup address and direct phone confirmed on the site's locations list. No public email.

listings.name: Perth Dexa Scan — Fremantle
listings.blurb: Scanning and testing on High Street, the Fremantle room of a business with six locations around the metro.
listings._source: perthdexascan.com.au — Fremantle address and direct phone confirmed on the site's locations list. No public email.

listings.name: Perth Dexa Scan — Beckenham
listings.blurb: The south-eastern room of a metro scanning business, on Albany Highway. Body composition and aerobic capacity testing by appointment.
listings._source: perthdexascan.com.au — Beckenham address and direct phone confirmed on the site's locations list, listed under its Cannington heading. No public email.
